headword: {供給不足|きょうきゅうぶそく}

definitions.gloss: supply shortage; insufficient supply relative to demand
definitions.explanation: A state in which the quantity of goods, materials, or labor available falls short of what buyers want, typically pushing prices up. Standard vocabulary in business news reporting.

examples.japanese: {半導体|はんどうたい}の{供給不足|きょうきゅうぶそく}が{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: The semiconductor supply shortage is continuing.

examples.japanese: {供給不足|きょうきゅうぶそく}で{価格|かかく}が{上|あ}がっている。
examples.english: Prices are rising because of the supply shortage.

examples.japanese: {天候|てんこう}{不順|ふじゅん}による{野菜|やさい}の{供給不足|きょうきゅうぶそく}が、{食品|しょくひん}{価格|かかく}を{押|お}し{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: A shortage of vegetables caused by unseasonable weather pushed food prices up.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {供給不足|きょうきゅうぶそく}に{陥|おちい}る: to fall into a supply shortage
- {供給不足|きょうきゅうぶそく}が{続|つづ}く: for a shortage to persist
- {供給不足|きょうきゅうぶそく}を{解消|かいしょう}する: to resolve a shortage
- {深刻|しんこく}な{供給不足|きょうきゅうぶそく}: a serious shortage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {品薄|しなうす}: low stock — describes shop shelves, a more everyday word
- {人手不足|ひとでぶそく}: labor shortage — the same {不足|ぶそく} pattern applied to workers
- {供給過剰|きょうきゅうかじょう}: oversupply — the opposite condition
